claim: Candidate-C physical touchscreen popup capture; no successor-runner result
fixture: Steam Deck Desktop Mode, Serum 2 2.1.5 candidate C
physical_actions: Mouse/trackpad opened and dismissed the waveform menu.
Finger touch opened the same dropdown.
A following finger tap could not select or dismiss it; the editor was unresponsive.

action_capture.window_graph_result: The mouse-opened popup was an owned, visible top-level Wine window. The touch-opened popup appeared near the action-window boundary; its later state was read separately.

stalled_popup_readback.reason: The fixed 16384-record Windows ring overflowed by 79 records after 16379 WM_POINTERUPDATE records; this is diagnostic partial evidence, not a complete input trace.

interpretation: The touch-opened popup remained visible with capture while continuing pointer updates targeted the editor child. A lost or misrouted touch end is plausible, but the action capture did not retain a complete XI touch Begin/End pair; source repair still requires a physical causal test. GetPointerInfo errors in the observer were its own read of pinned Wine's stub, not evidence of a vendor API call.
nonclaims: No claim that the original touch release was captured with exact pointer flags.
No claim that the popup owner chain is absent; this popup had an owner.
No claim that a generated fixture or candidate D has passed.
No claim that the recorded audio delivery gap was caused by this touch action.
post_capture: Operator closed Bitwig normally. Candidate C and all six current publications were not changed by capture.
